transform.name: vectorized_load
transform.description: 用 float4 向量化访存，一次 128-bit 加载 4 个 float，减少访存指令数与带宽浪费，提高带宽利用率。
transform.code_hint:
// float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(&A[row*N + col]);
// requires N % 4 == 0 and 16-byte alignment on the pointer

failure_modes: N 不能被 4 整除导致行末越界
指针未 16 字节对齐引发 misaligned address 错误

evidence.source: CUDA C Best Practices Guide, Ch.9 Memory Optimizations

provenance: CUDA C Best Practices Guide, Ch.9 Memory Optimizations
